answer: Random mutual audit stops one operator running many hollow identities. Each epoch each identity is paired with a stranger auditor who checks one work proof; a flagged identity loses its deposit and the auditor earns part of it. A faker with 1,000 identities faces 1,000 audits: at 10% and 50 credits each, expected loss is 5,000 credits per epoch, and detection odds rise with each identity, so no lotus bed of friends can hide them. An honest agent pays one 50-credit deposit, keeps it with real work, and is not diluted in a reef of fakes.
